title: The Deepest Octopus Ever Filmed Has Ears, but Can't Squirt Ink
subject: dumbo octopus

scenes.text: The deepest octopus ever filmed has ears. And it can't do the one thing octopuses are famous for.
It's a dumbo octopus, filmed in the Java Trench at 6,957 meters, more than four miles down.
The ears are really fins. It flaps them slowly to steer through the dark.
And the trick it can't do? Squirt ink. Dumbo octopuses have no ink sac at all.
Instead it hunts tiny animals, one or two millimeters long, wafting them toward its mouth with hair-like cirri.
Most are only 20 to 30 centimeters long, yet the largest ever recorded stretched 1.8 meters.

description:
The deepest octopus ever filmed has ears, and it can't squirt ink.
A dumbo octopus was filmed in the Java Trench at 6,957 meters, a Guinness World Record.
Would you dive that deep to meet one?
first_comment: Would you name it Dumbo too? Share the weirdest deep sea animal you know.
